headline: Fog is slowing San Francisco arrivals and departures.

items.text: Very low clouds, very low visibility and fog at San Francisco (SFO) are slowing arrivals and departures significantly.
No FAA ground stop or ground delay program is in effect at any United hub, and the network disruption index is 12.6, in the normal range (under 20).
Apart from San Francisco, the other hubs are running normally; all seven hubs reporting yesterday were at 84% on time or better.
